title: Prime Big Deal Days: Our biggest deals to kick off fall and holiday shopping October 6-7
summary: Prime members can shop millions of deals during the 48-hour event, from fall fashion and trending beauty to holiday gifting, and everyday essentials.
body_markdown:
[Prime Big Deal Days 2026 is officially here](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/best-prime-big-deal-days-2026-top-deals) through October 7, giving Prime members 48 hours to shop the best deals on fall favorites, Halloween essentials, game-day gatherings, and holiday gifting across fashion, electronics, beauty, toys, home, and more.


---


## Key takeaways


- [Prime Big Deal Days 2026](https://www.aboutamazon.com/prime-big-deal-days) runs October 6–7 with millions of deals across fashion, electronics, beauty, toys, and more, including everything you need for fall wardrobe refreshes, Halloween and game-day gatherings, and getting a head start on holiday gifting.


- Today's Big Deals drop three times daily at up to 55% or more off—most at Amazon's lowest prices of the year so far.


- [Alexa for Shopping](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-use-amazon-shopping-ai-assistant) can set deal alerts, track price drops, and notify you when items on your


[Lists](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-wish-list) go on sale.


---


[Prime Big Deal Days 2026](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-big-deal-days-faq) returns October 6–7, giving Prime members two days to shop millions of member-exclusive deals starting at 12:01 a.m. PDT. Customers already count on Amazon for


[low prices every day](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-affordable-everyday-savings) . Prime Big Deal Days takes savings even further, with deals at Amazon's lowest prices of the year so far, and on premium beauty brands like Charlotte Tilbury and La Roche-Posay. Members will also find savings on products from brands they love, with up to 40% off select top brands and new deals continuing to go live throughout the event.


[Prime Big Deal Days 2026: Early deals you can shop right now](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/prime-big-deal-days-2026-best-deals-amazon)


Prime members can start saving ahead of Prime Big Deal Days 2026, returning October 6–7, with deals on devices, Kindle, Amazon Music, and more.


Whether members are building the perfect tailgate setup, decorating for Halloween, or getting a head start on gifts, they'll find something for every seasonal moment—including our Top 100+ Fall Favorites featuring Staub pumpkin cookware and a Ninja Woodfire grill, plus deals on items from new-to-Amazon brands like First Aid Beauty and FAO Schwarz, and exclusive products they won't find anywhere else.


Today's Big Deals are back, featuring limited-time offers at up to 55% or more off—most at Amazon's lowest prices of the year so far. New drops launch three times daily throughout the event—at midnight, 8 a.m., and 1 p.m. PDT—featuring trending products and new releases across tech, home, kitchen, fashion, and beauty. This year's lineup includes drops on everything from $2,000 off a big-screen TV from Sony to up to 50% off trending K-beauty from medicube and Dr.Jart+. These deals are exclusive to Prime members and available only while supplies last.

## Let Alexa for Shopping help you save during Prime Big Deal Days


With so much to shop for, Alexa for Shopping helps you stay on top of it all—so you don't have to keep checking. Just tell Alexa what you're looking for, and it can surface relevant deals, show you price history so you know you're getting a great value, and send alerts when items on your Lists drop in price or when new deals match your interests. You can also set a target price on any item and turn on Auto-Buy so Alexa purchases automatically when it hits your price.


- Track what matters to you:


Create Deal Alerts to track deals for specific needs, set a target price on any item to get notified when the price drops, or turn on Auto-Buy so Alexa purchases automatically when it hits your target.


- Stay ahead of holiday drops:


Ask Alexa for Shopping to “update me when \[brand\] releases something new” for anyone on your List.


- Shop with confidence:


Tap “


[Price History](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-check-amazon-price-history) ” on any product detail page, or ask Alexa for Shopping, to see up to 365 days of pricing insights.


- Keep your Lists ready for the season:


[Create Lists](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-wish-list) for every occasion—from holiday gift ideas to fall home refresh projects—and get notified when items on your Lists drop in price or go on deal. Share your Lists with family and friends so they know exactly what to get you this holiday season.


Learn more about how


[Alexa for Shopping](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-ai-shopping-tools) can help you save this season.

Prime Big Deal Days 2026 starts on October 6, and these AI shopping tools can help you find, track, and score the best deals.

## How do I sign up for Prime?


Anyone can


[join Prime in the U.S.](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-sign-up-for-a-prime-membership) for $14.99 per month or $139 per year, or


[start a free 30-day trial](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) if eligible.


Prime also offers discounted membership options:


- [Prime for Young Adults](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-for-young-adults) : Higher education students and 18- to 24-year-olds can try a six-month free trial, then pay $7.49 per month or $69 per year.


- [Prime Access](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) : Qualifying government-assistance recipients and income-verified customers can try Prime free for 30 days, then pay $6.99 per month.


Prime members in 22 countries can shop Prime Big Deal Days this season; dates may vary per country.
